theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi rtsa tshig mchan bsgrags ma bzhugs so/ /dpal bkra shis rin po che myur du bde ba thams cad sbyin pa don thams cad grub pa

tei:div.tei:p: theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi rtsa tshig mchan bsgrags ma bzhugs so/ /dpal bkra shis rin po che myur du bde ba thams cad sbyin pa don thams cad grub pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po rten gyi gang zag skyes bu gsum la blo sbyong zhing smon 'jug gnyis blangs nas bslab bya shes pa gcig gis sngon 'gro dag dal 'byor thob dka' ba las rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam la bslab/ /chos rnams rang gzhan phyi nang snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i rmi lam lta bur sems 'khrul pa'i dbang gis med bzhin snang bsam/ /ma skyes shing ma 'gag pa'i rig pa de ltar rtogs mkhan gyi blo gshis la dpyod/ /ngos bzung bral ba gnyen po nyid kyang de ltar lus sems gnyis la gcod byed kyi rang sar yod med du 'dzin pa dang bral ba grol/ /thun mtshams de'i rjes la sgyu ma'i skyes pa'i dus su gong ma gnyis la brten nas skyes bur bya/ /gtong lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge ba thams cad gzhan la len gnyis po spel mar sbyangs/ /gtong len de gnyis rlung phyir 'gro na la bskyon par bya/ /sdug mi sdug bar ma yul gsum chags sdang gti mug chod pa'i dug gsum dge rtsa gsum/ /bsags pa la sogs pa'i spyod lam kun tu rjes su yid gtad pa tshig gis sbyangs/ /snod phyi bcud nang sdig 'bras bu duḥkha pa 'khor ba yi/ /zhing nyon mongs rkyen ngan sems can dang 'byung ba las gyur pa'i byang chub ci byung thams cad lam du bsgyur/ / grogs su le lan ji ltar na thams cad mi 'dod pa ci byung ba thams cad gzhan la mi gda' bar bdag 'dzin gcig la gda'/ /kun la mi dang mi min dgra gnyen khyad par du gnod byed bka' drin che bar bsgom/ /'khrul snang rang sems nas sku gnod bya gnod byed bzhir lag bcangs su gtad pa bsgom pa yi/ /stong thams cad sems kyi ngo bo nyid bsrung ba rnams kyi nang nas bla na med/

/sbyor ba bzhi lha dang bla ma mchod pa sdig pa sbyang ba gdon la mchod pa chos skyong mchod pa ldan thabs kyi mchog /'phral la gang thub bsgom du sbyar/ /sdug bsngal dang chags sdang drag po skyes pa'i rkyen ngan man ngag tshe gcig nyams su blangs pa'i gnad bstan pa'o/ snying po mdor bsdus pa/ /stobs lnga dag 'phen pa'i goms pa'i la sbyar bar bya/ /dkar po sa bon gyi sun 'byin pa'i smon lam gyis pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyi/ theg chen 'pho ba'i gdams ngag ni/ /sngar gyi stobs lnga khyad par du nyid yin spyod lam gces/ /kyi gnad bca' ba/ chos kun dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus/ /des thul ma thul blta ba'i/ dpang po gnyis kyi gzhan gyi ngag dang rang gi sems de gnyis rang gi sems kyis ma khrel ba mi thogs la 'dod thog tu blo sbyong ba'i byung ngo / gtso bor bzung / /yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du bsten/ /yengs kyang thub na gnyen po blo 'byongs pa yin/ /spyi blo sbyong khas blangs dang mig tho cor ma song don gsum la rtag tu bslab/ /'dun pa sngon la rang gces par 'dzin pa'i bsgyur la ma bcol ba'i don la rang sor bzhag /lus ngag gi spyod pa/ yan lag nyams pa brjod mi bya/ /gzhan phyogs khyad par du chos sgor du bzhugs pa'i gang yang mi bsam mo/ /song / 'bras bu blo sbyongs pas tshe 'di dang phyi mar tha na sangs rgyas thob par re ba thams cad spangs/ /dug can dang blta ba bdag 'dzin dang 'dres pa'i dge ba gyi zas spangs/ gzhung gzhan gyi gnod pa byas pa'i le 'chang ba'i bzang po mi bsten/ shags ngan ma gzhan gyi snying la gzer ba'i 'god/ 'phrang zhe lan 'jal ba'i ma dgug /gnad la mi dang mi ma yin dang su la yang skyon gyi mi dbab/ mdzo khal mi 'dod pa'i khag ngan khur logs pa glang la ma 'byo/ mgyogs 'dod pa spyi sa na yod pa la rang la sna gtod kyi rtse 'pham blangs pas 'jug ma gtod/ rang rgyal du re ba'i lto log mi bya/

dang 'dra ba'i blo sbyong / lha bdud du mi dbab/ rang skyid par 'dod pa'i kyi yan lag tu gzhan la sdug ma 'tshol/ rnal zas la sogs pa'i 'byor thams cad la gzhan med kyi gcig gis bya/ /nang pa dang / thog ma dgong mtha' gnyis spyod pa yis la bya ba gnyis/ /rim pa ltar phan pa dang / gnyis po gang mi khengs par rang zhum pa med byung bzod par bya/ /gnyis po chos spyod nas bshad pa'i dam tshig dang khyad par du 'di nyid nas bshad pa'i dam tshig srog dang bsdos la bsrung / /dka' ba gsum la nyon mongs pa gnyen po dran dka'/ bar du bzlog dka'/ tha mar rgyun bcad dka' ba bla ma mtshan ldan rang gi blo bkol du btub phyi nang gi mthun rkyen tshang ba ste bslab par bya/ /rgyu yi gtso bo rnam gsum blang / /nyams pa bla ma gus sems med pa rnam gsum bsgom/ /'bral med gsum dang dag sbyar gsum dang lus ngag yid gsum dang 'gran ngos su 'dug pa ldan par byas/ /bskol pa lhan cig na 'dug /rang la sdang ba/ rang gi yid du mi 'ong ba rnams la rtag tu bsgom/ /rkyen gzhan blo sbyong 'di sgom pa'i drin can de dag la ltos mi mi dgos par blta ba bya/ /log na blo sbyong gi sgom dus mi gtub par blo'i rgyu mtshan du byas la de nyid gnyen por bsgom/ /da dal 'byor thob cing bla ma dam pa dang mjal ba'i dus las dang po ba gtso bor gyur pa'i byang sems res gtso bo nyams su blangs/ /go log dge sbyor la spro dga' bslab la bag yod drug po mi bya/ res 'jog mi bya/ sbyong mi sbyong dol chod du sbyangs/ gtub mi gtub tshad len gyi bya ba/ rtog dpyod gnyis bdag 'dzin yong ba la kyi mthar bya/ rang rgyud la dpe goms ma goms/ yus su la yang gang gi sgom dus nam yang ma bsgom/ ko long rang la gzhan gyis ji ltar byas kyang sems kyi mi sdom/ yud tsam pa dga' mi dga'i rnam 'gyur ston pa'i mi rtag mi bya/ 'or che zhes pa'i tshig gi bar gtang rag tsam yang ma 'dod/

rdo rje nyi ma pha lam dang ljon shing ltar/ rnam smin dang tha na sman chen po'i tshig don la 'di'i brjod byed dang brjod bya sogs shes sgom pa'i dgos pa la sogs par bya/ /snyigs ma blo sbyong sgom pa'i rkyen mang la de tsa na blo sbyong bas lnga po bdo ba 'dis/ /byang chub lam du sbyor ba'i grogs su bsgyur ba yin/ /jo bo chen po'i thugs dam 'phags pa byams pa nas brgyud bcom ldan 'das kyi byams pa la/ byams pas 'phags pa thogs med la/ des dbyig gnyen/ des rir ma ti/ des ku sa li che ba/ des ku sa li chung ba/ des bla ma gser gling pa'o pa'i gdams ngag rdzogs so// ༈ //phyogs su 'dzin pa lha sde'i dang 'byor rgud kyi res 'ga' ba rang gzhan la rgyu sdig pa thams cad spangs/ /thams cad dus snyigs ma kun slong nyon mongs pa theg chen lam du bsgyur/ /khyab mi sde rnal 'byor thams cad dang spyod lam dang gting 'byongs kun la sems kyi skad cig ma skyes tshad 'dis ngo bo sdug bsngal la sogs pa gces/ /dngos dang yan gtong len gnyis dam tshig dang bslab bya/ lha 'dre rnam gsum pa mi bya bar bdag 'dzin lag gnyis ka sbyangs/ /drag 'jun spong len drag tu bya/ /mi mthun bsgom gyi grogs su bsgyur/ /rgyu mtshan gtong len bsgom snying mi 'dod pa'i gzhan gyi gnod pa bya snyam pa la sogs pa thams cad gzhom par bya/ /nyon mongs rang gi rgyud la nyan btags nas gal che ba de'i gnyen po bsten pa sems can thams cad la nye ring byams sdang / mtho dman bem rig dang gang che sngon du sbyangs/ /yul la phyogs med dag tu 'di la blo phebs na thams cad grogs su 'gyur ba dang sbyangs/ /yon tan gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ gtam thos pa tsam gyi nus pa yang dang yang du gnyis po sdug bsngal bskyungs pas gzhan gyi de nyid rang la tshang nas thams cad blangs/ /nyams su blangs 'di dngos po thob pa'i rtogs pa yin yang da lta nas bsam pa sla bar bslab/

len pa'i tshe mjug la smin rgyu rang gi rtsa ba'i ma go rim rang dang brtsams/ /bya bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom pa ba'i mtshan nyid btang ba yin/ 'di phyi 'khor 'das thams cad la chags zhen 'byongs blo rtags chen po lnga ldan yul 'dzin dge slong sgom pa gtso bo yin/ /mgron po mi byang sems dang gces par byas gzhan gyi bya/ dag gsal mi bya/ nyes skyon mi 'byung bas rang gis/ re ltos gzhan la mi bya/ rdzogs so/ /gzhan la mang po blangs gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bskyungs kyi rig ma 'ongs pa la rtag du go bgo /mi tshe 'khor ba'i rgyu thams cad kyi ma shor bar bya snyam du/ brtan pa thob nas gtong len gnyis po zab mo'i don bdag dang gzhan dang sdig sdug bde bogs grub pa myong ba'o/ /'di jo bo'i mdzad pa gsang ba bstan pa yin/ blo sbyong gi gzhung rdzogs so// //he 'dzum// //dge'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a ti sha/ theg chen blo sbyong gi tshig 'grel/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
